connector.name: Livetennisapi MCP
connector.registryDescription: Real-time tennis scores, players, odds and model win-probability for ATP, WTA, Challenger, ITF.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.livetennisapi.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package livetennisapi-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the livetennisapi account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer twjp_… — your Live Tennis API key. Tools are listable without it; calling one needs it. Free key, no card: https://livetennisapi.com/subscribe/free

env.name: LIVETENNISAPI_KEY
env.description: Your Live Tennis API key (twjp_...). Get one free, no card, at https://livetennisapi.com/subscribe/free — the server runs without it but only the status check will work.
